title: ISO 8601 date and time format
text: ISO 8601 is an international standard covering the exchange of date and time related data. It specifies the calendar date format YYYY-MM-DD.

title: RFC 4180: Common Format and MIME Type for CSV Files
text: RFC 4180 documents the format used for comma-separated values (CSV) files and registers the MIME type text/csv. CSV is a plain text tabular format.

title: DOI Handbook
text: A digital object identifier (DOI) is a persistent identifier. A DOI is not a URL, although it resolves through one; a DOI does not change when the object moves.
